description_en: Pauses a SQL task for data change
description_zh: 暂停执行数据变更工单SQL任务
name: PauseDataCorrectSQLJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data change ticket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html operation to query the ID of the data change ticket
parameters.help_zh: 数据变更工单ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the pause operation. Valid values:

ALL: pauses all SQL tasks.
SINGLE: pauses a single SQL task
parameters.help_zh:
暂停类型，取值如下：

ALL：全部暂停
SINGLE：暂停单个任务
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the SQL task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208481.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207049.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

If Type is set to SINGLE, you must pass in the value of JobId to confirm the ID of the SQL task that you want to pause
parameters.help_zh:
SQL任务ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208481.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207049.html获取该参数的值。
如果type = SINGLE，需要传递JobId确认需要重试的SQL任务ID
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code that is returned

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that is returned

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
